summary: No call stack is returned or documented to callers.
Every applied tableView is validated first.
Every contract parameter is a key the code reads, and every key the code reads is declared (0 allow-listed).
No obsolete declaration and no AL0432/AL0667 pragma in the app, apart from the allow-listed VAT Amount Line pragmas.
Every page, query, report and xmlport is granted by an assignable permission set.
No procedure answers a Locked English sentence.
Every Icelandic keyword list has at least as many entries as the English one (1 in the source, 1 in the xlf).
The committed is-IS.xlf is what tools/Update-IcelandicXlf.ps1 generates from the build.
